title: Retrospective, single-center analysis of genetic diagnostics in retinoblastoma: mapping systematic genotype–phenotype associations to enable model-based risk prediction and identify causal mechanisms.
summary: Verbesserte Beurteilung der manifestationsbezogenen Effekte von RB1-Varianten (Penetranz/Expressivität); Parent-of-Origin-Effekte auf Penetranz/Expressivität (epigenetischer Status); Entwicklung eines probabilistischen Modells zur Integration von Pathogenität, Epigenetik, Penetranz/Expressivität (altersabhängig)

interventions.name:
Non-interventional: observational study / epidemiological study (retrospective cohort/registry analysis)
Structured, case-by-case capture of the variables required for the analysis from the existing medical records of the specialist retinoblastoma genetics clinic (Ophthalmic Oncology and Genetics r

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Availability of documented clinical and/or molecular genetic data from the specialist clinic (collected since 1986); diagnosis of retinoblastoma or RB1 pathogenic variant carrier status; where applicable, relatives with collected data.
Exclusion criteria:
none
sponsor: Forschergruppe Ophthalmologische Onkologie und Genetik/Universitätsklinikum Essen
